positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Engineering Lead for "Oscar Unlocks" and "Oswell AI Bot" (2025): Directing technical strategy and execution for flagship 2025 initiatives, focused on increasing digital engagement and seamless member experiences via AI driven prescription renewal, care routing, and escalations. This involved coordination across multiple engineers, product stakeholders, executive leadership, and design. 
* Solo engineer for Oscar’s first member-facing AI use case - AI Clinical Intake Bot (2024)
* Solo engineer to integrate patient messaging into Oscar’s internal EMR (2024)
* Tech Lead (2022+) and Engineering Manager (2025+) for various teams

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Promoted to Tech Lead of the Member-Facing Virtual Care team in 2022, serving as the primary technical resource for the team and supporting the onboarding of senior engineers and managers to scale the organization.
* At the start of the pandemic, pivoted to the Member Experience team and contributed to the rapid development and pilot of Oscar’s Virtual Primary Care experience, supporting the team through iterative builds to achieve a successful full-scale launch in 2021.
* Delivered core enhancements to the Provider Portal, including a major revamp of the Prior Authorizations views, large-scale member data migrations, and the integration of Capsule RX refill capabilities (2019).
